messages.subject: behaviour of population ordering for genlight and gl.pcoa/glpca
parts:
Hi,
I'm curious about how to control the ordering of the populations in a genlight file and specifically WRT running gl.pcoa or glpca analysis. If I look at pops in my genlight file via e.g. my.gl$pops I have a particular order - I presume it was the input order of my data originally.  However, when I run gl.pca the order of my pops is alphabetical (as seen in the assignment of colours and in the legend. I would like to be able to control population order in both my genlight and any outputs from gl.pcoa (or glpca). Any advice? I'm sure its straightforward.
Cheers,
Olly
